svg.title: s3mirror - no vendor lock-in, copy what changed
svg.desc: A cyan source bucket and an orange destination bucket drawn in dots, joined by seven parallel worker lanes carrying objects at different speeds, one of them a multipart upload, with a ping wherever an object lands.

text.tspan: Buckets and objects between S3-compatible endpoints,
one config, clear logs. --no-delete keeps it copy-only.
